basis.governing_question: What is the current state of patient waiting times at Norte Hospitals Group's three hospitals?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Measure and explain patient waiting times across the three hospitals, and identify where and why delays occur.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Does the sponsor approve the waiting-time diagnostic as the final result?

workstreams.name: Waiting-time baseline
workstreams.answers: How long do patients wait at each of the three hospitals today, and how does that vary?
activities: Agree waiting-time definitions with the sponsor
Collect waiting-time data from operational records
Compute baseline waits for each hospital

workstreams.name: Patient pathway delays
workstreams.answers: At which steps of the patient pathway do waits build up, and at which hospitals?
activities: Interview staff who run each step of the patient pathway
Measure queue times at each step from operational data
Walk the pathway at each hospital to observe waits

workstreams.name: Causes of delay
workstreams.answers: Why do the delays occur, and do the causes differ between the three hospitals?
activities: Interview clinicians and administrative staff on delays
Test candidate causes against operational data

workstreams.name: Diagnostic synthesis
workstreams.answers: What is the current state of waiting times across the three hospitals, taken together?
activities: Combine baseline, pathway and cause findings
Test findings with the sponsor before the readout
Prepare the final readout for the sponsor

deliverables.name: Waiting-time baseline for the three hospitals
Patient pathway delays by step and hospital

events.label: Kick-off
events.decision: Does the sponsor confirm the scope, team and calendar for the diagnostic?
agenda: Confirm the scope: patient waiting times at the three hospitals
Align on team roles and how the sponsor will steer the work
Confirm the calendar: check-in in week 4, final readout in week 6

events.label: Check-in: early findings
events.purpose: Review baseline and pathway delay findings
events.decision: Which pathway steps should the causes analysis examine in most detail?
agenda: Present the waiting-time baseline for the three hospitals
Review patient pathway delays by step and hospital
Decide which pathway steps the causes analysis examines in most detail

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Present the diagnostic for sponsor approval
events.decision: Does the sponsor approve the waiting-time diagnostic as the final result?
agenda: Present the waiting-time diagnostic final readout
Review the baseline, pathway delays and causes of delay by hospital
Decide on approval of the diagnostic as the final result

architect_notes: Archetype performance_improvement is used for its Diagnostic phase only; its Implementation phase is dropped because the brief is assessment-only.
Six weeks make one Diagnostic phase: a stage under three weeks belongs inside its neighbor, and the four workstreams run side by side.
